description: This Java class models the description for a product option within a sales management system. It uses JPA annotations for ORM mapping, defining relationships and database schema details.

classes.name: ProductOptionDescription
classes.description: Entity class representing the description of a product option, including comments and a link to the ProductOption entity.

methods.name: getProductOptionComment
methods.description: Returns the comment associated with the product option description.

methods.name: setProductOptionComment
methods.description: Sets the comment for the product option description.

methods.name: setProductOption
methods.description: Associates a ProductOption entity with this description.
